column1: # Frontend licence overrides, read by npm-licenses.mjs. TAB-separated columns:
#   kind      `license` (fills in a licence the lockfile and the installed
#             package.json do not declare) or `allow` (accepts a licence
#             classed as "review" for the matching packages)
#   package   package name; `*` matches any run of characters
#   license   SPDX expression. For `allow` it must equal the declared expression
#             exactly, so an upstream licence change fails the check again.
#   reason    why the row exists
# For each kind, the first matching row wins, so put specific rows before broad ones.
# A `license` row never replaces a declared licence, and an `allow` row cannot
# accept a forbidden licence (GPL, AGPL, SSPL, BUSL, NC, ND, UNLICENSED).
# `license` rows: optional platform binaries absent from local node_modules
# whose lockfile entry declares no licence. Since sharp 0.35.5 every @img/*
# and @emnapi/runtime entry declares one in the lockfile, so only the
# @napi-rs/canvas platform packages still need a row; the value was checked
# with `npm view <pkg>@0.1.92 license` on 2026-10-03. Re-check after upgrading.
license
# `allow` rows: licences classed as review that are acceptable for shipping.
allow
